# Renoun Skis

> > Premium handmade skis featuring VibeStop™ vibration-dampening technology, designed in Vermont and manufactured in Québec with a direct-to-consumer membership model.

Renoun specializes in all-mountain, powder, and carving skis with proprietary VibeStop™ (HDT) technology that reduces vibration by 300%. Founded by Vermont native Cyrus Schenck, the company offers RenounPro membership with SwapAnytime™ benefits and a customer-centric approach to ski equipment.

## Key Topics

- VibeStop™ technology
- HDT (High Damping Technology)
- RenounPro membership
- SwapAnytime™ program
- All-mountain skis
- Powder skis (Citadel 107)
- Carving skis (Atlas 80)
- Endurance 98 & Endurance 88
- Earhart 88
- Made in North America (Vermont/Québec)
- Vibration dampening
- TryOnSnow program
- Direct-to-consumer model
- Handmade skis
- Cyrus Schenck (founder)
